mapper.sql: FROM electronic_ticket t LEFT JOIN ticket_order o ON o.order_id = t.order_id LEFT JOIN user_account u ON u.user_id = o.user_id LEFT JOIN performance_project p ON p.project_id = o.project_id LEFT JOIN performance_session s ON s.session_id = o.session_id LEFT JOIN venue v ON v.venue_id = s.venue_id LEFT JOIN order_item oi ON oi.order_item_id = t.order_item_id LEFT JOIN order_audience oa ON oa.order_audience_id = t.order_audience_id LEFT JOIN ticket_source_provider tsp ON tsp.provider_id = t.source_provider_id

t.ticket_id AS ticketId, t.ticket_no AS ticketNo, t.order_id AS orderId, o.order_no AS orderNo, o.user_id AS userId, u.phone AS userPhone, u.nickname AS nickname, o.project_id AS projectId, p.title AS projectTitle, o.session_id AS sessionId, s.city_name AS cityName, s.station_name AS stationName, v.venue_name AS venueName, s.start_time AS startTime, t.order_item_id AS orderItemId, oi.sku_id AS skuId, oi.sku_name AS skuName, t.order_audience_id AS orderAudienceId, oa.real_name AS audienceName, oa.certificate_type AS certificateType, oa.certificate_no AS certificateNo, t.ticket_status AS ticketStatus, o.fulfillment_mode AS fulfillmentMode, t.source_provider_id AS sourceProviderId, tsp.provider_code AS sourceProviderCode, t.provider_ticket_id AS providerTicketId, t.credential_type AS credentialType, t.seat_info AS seatInfo, t.seat_zone AS seatZone, t.seat_row AS seatRow, t.seat_number AS seatNumber, t.generate_time AS generateTime, t.provider_issue_time AS providerIssueTime, t.check_time AS checkTime, t.expire_time AS expireTime, t.abnormal_reason AS abnormalReason, t.create_time AS createTime, t.update_time AS updateTime

where.if: AND ( CAST(t.ticket_id AS CHAR) = #{keyword} OR t.ticket_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR o.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR oa.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR oa.certificate_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

mapper.select:
SELECT t.ticket_id AS ticketId, t.ticket_no AS ticketNo, t.ticket_status AS ticketStatus, o.fulfillment_mode AS fulfillmentMode, t.source_provider_id AS sourceProviderId, tsp.provider_code AS sourceProviderCode, t.provider_order_id AS providerOrderId, t.provider_ticket_id AS providerTicketId, t.credential_type AS credentialType, t.credential_payload AS credentialPayload, t.credential_version AS credentialVersion, t.qr_code_value AS qrCodeValue, t.seat_info AS seatInfo, t.seat_zone AS seatZone, t.seat_row AS seatRow, t.seat_number AS seatNumber, t.entrance_info AS entranceInfo, t.generate_time AS generateTime, t.provider_issue_time AS providerIssueTime, t.last_source_sync_time AS lastSourceSyncTime, t.check_time AS checkTime, t.expire_time AS expireTime, t.abnormal_reason AS abnormalReason, t.create_time AS createTime, t.update_time AS updateTime, o.order_id AS orderId, o.order_no AS orderNo, o.order_status AS orderStatus, o.delivery_type AS deliveryType, o.pay_amount AS payAmount, o.user_id AS userId, u.phone AS userPhone, u.nickname AS nickname, o.project_id AS projectId, p.title AS projectTitle, p.poster_url AS posterUrl, o.session_id AS sessionId, s.city_name AS cityName, s.station_name AS stationName, s.start_time AS startTime, s.end_time AS endTime, s.venue_id AS venueId, v.venue_name AS venueName, v.address AS venueAddress, t.order_item_id AS orderItemId, oi.sku_id AS skuId, oi.sku_name AS skuName, oi.unit_price AS unitPrice, t.order_audience_id AS orderAudienceId, oa.real_name AS audienceName, oa.certificate_type AS certificateType, oa.certificate_no AS certificateNo, oa.phone AS audiencePhone
WHERE t.ticket_id = #{ticketId} LIMIT 1
SELECT fulfillment_mode FROM ticket_order WHERE order_id=#{orderId} LIMIT 1

SELECT t.ticket_id AS ticketId, t.order_id AS orderId, t.ticket_status AS ticketStatus, o.order_status AS orderStatus FROM electronic_ticket t INNER JOIN ticket_order o ON o.order_id = t.order_id WHERE t.ticket_id = #{ticketId} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE electronic_ticket SET ticket_status = 'ERROR', qr_code_value = NULL, generate_time = NULL, check_time = NULL, expire_time = NULL, abnormal_reason = #{abnormalReason}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE ticket_id = #{ticketId} AND ticket_status IN ('GENERATING', 'UNUSED')

UPDATE electronic_ticket SET ticket_status = 'GENERATING', qr_code_value = NULL, generate_time = NULL, check_time = NULL, expire_time = NULL, abnormal_reason = NULL, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE ticket_id = #{ticketId} AND ticket_status = 'ERROR'
mapper.sql: CASE WHEN COUNT(t.ticket_id) = 0 THEN 'NO_TICKET' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN t.ticket_status = 'ERROR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN t.ticket_status IN ('UNUSED', 'CHECKED', 'EXPIRED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'PARTIAL' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN t.ticket_status = 'ERROR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'ERROR' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN t.ticket_status = 'GENERATING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN t.ticket_status IN ('UNUSED', 'CHECKED', 'EXPIRED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'PARTIAL' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN t.ticket_status = 'GENERATING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'GENERATING' ELSE 'ISSUED' END
mapper.select: SELECT o.order_id AS orderId, o.order_no AS orderNo, o.order_status AS orderStatus, o.pay_amount AS payAmount, o.project_id AS projectId, p.title AS projectTitle, o.session_id AS sessionId, s.city_name AS cityName, s.station_name AS stationName, v.venue_name AS venueName, s.start_time AS startTime, o.ticket_issued_time AS ticketIssuedTime, COUNT(t.ticket_id) AS totalTicketCount, SUM(CASE WHEN t.ticket_status = 'GENERATING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS generatingCount, SUM(CASE WHEN t.ticket_status = 'ERROR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS errorCount, SUM(CASE WHEN t.ticket_status = 'UNUSED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unusedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN t.ticket_status = 'CHECKED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS checkedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN t.ticket_status = 'EXPIRED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS expiredCount, AS issueStatus FROM ticket_order o LEFT JOIN performance_project p ON p.project_id = o.project_id LEFT JOIN performance_session s ON s.session_id = o.session_id LEFT JOIN venue v ON v.venue_id = s.venue_id LEFT JOIN electronic_ticket t ON t.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_id = #{orderId} GROUP BY o.order_id, o.order_no, o.order_status, o.pay_amount, o.project_id, p.title, o.session_id, s.city_name, s.station_name, v.venue_name, s.start_time, o.ticket_issued_time LIMIT 1

SELECT order_id AS orderId, order_status AS orderStatus, fulfillment_mode AS fulfillmentMode, pay_amount AS payAmount, ticket_issued_time AS ticketIssuedTime FROM ticket_order WHERE order_id = #{orderId} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM electronic_ticket WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND ticket_status IN ('GENERATING', 'ERROR')
mapper.update: UPDATE electronic_ticket SET ticket_status = 'UNUSED', qr_code_value = CONCAT('MAIMAI_QR_', ticket_no, '_', DATE_FORMAT(#{issueTime}, '%Y%m%d%H%i%s')), generate_time = #{issueTime}, check_time = NULL, expire_time = NULL, abnormal_reason = NULL, update_time = #{issueTime} WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND ticket_status IN ('GENERATING', 'ERROR')

UPDATE electronic_ticket SET ticket_status = 'ERROR', qr_code_value = NULL, generate_time = NULL, check_time = NULL, expire_time = NULL, abnormal_reason = #{abnormalReason}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND ticket_status IN ('GENERATING', 'UNUSED')

UPDATE electronic_ticket SET ticket_status = 'GENERATING', qr_code_value = NULL, generate_time = NULL, check_time = NULL, expire_time = NULL, abnormal_reason = NULL, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND ticket_status = 'ERROR'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM electronic_ticket WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND ticket_status = 'CHECKED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM electronic_ticket WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND ticket_status = 'ERROR'
mapper.update: UPDATE electronic_ticket SET ticket_status = 'EXPIRED', qr_code_value = NULL, check_time = NULL, expire_time = #{expireTime}, abnormal_reason = #{abnormalReason}, update_time = #{expireTime} WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND ticket_status IN ('GENERATING', 'ERROR', 'UNUSED')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO refund_record (refund_no, order_id, refund_rule_id, matched_stage_id, refund_type_snapshot, fee_rate_snapshot, apply_time, reason, refund_amount, fee_amount, refund_status, refund_time, fail_reason, update_time) VALUES (#{refundNo}, #{orderId}, NULL, NULL, #{refundTypeSnapshot}, NULL, #{applyTime}, #{reason}, #{refundAmount}, #{feeAmount}, #{refundStatus}, #{refundTime}, NULL, #{updateTime})
mapper.sql: t.ticket_id AS ticketId, t.ticket_no AS ticketNo, t.ticket_status AS ticketStatus, t.seat_info AS seatInfo, t.check_time AS checkTime, o.order_id AS orderId, o.order_no AS orderNo, o.order_status AS orderStatus, p.title AS projectTitle, o.session_id AS sessionId, s.city_name AS cityName, s.station_name AS stationName, v.venue_name AS venueName, v.address AS venueAddress, s.start_time AS startTime, oa.real_name AS audienceName, oa.certificate_type AS certificateType, oa.certificate_no AS certificateNo
mapper.update: UPDATE ticket_order o SET o.order_status = 'FINISHED', o.finish_time = #{finishTime}, o.update_time = #{finishTime} WHERE o.order_id = #{orderId} AND o.order_status = 'WAIT_USE' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM electronic_ticket t WHERE t.order_id = o.order_id ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM electronic_ticket t WHERE t.order_id = o.order_id AND t.ticket_status <> 'CHECKED' )
